text:
karen: deploy-bot paused the checkout canary. It flagged a values-override drift between the release request and the deployed artifact. canary id=canary-checkout-2026-04. Anyone able to triage?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] CANARY PAUSED: values override mismatch detected. requested artifact: checkout v6.2.0 (artifact digest: sha256:ff11), requested values override includes `promotions.enableBeta=true`, deployed artifact applies values with `promotions.enableBeta=false`. 7/80 pods failed readiness. Action: PAUSE_CANARY. See /deploy/logs/3109991111

diego: that is interesting — chart & subcharts match, but the release request included a values overlay in the PR that sets `promotions.enableBeta=true`. Looks like the promoted artifact omitted the values overlay during packaging.

karen: so the artifact digest matches our chart, but the values blob didn't make it into the promoted bundle. Options: (1) manual pin canary to existing live values (disable beta) to stop churn, (2) re-publish artifact including values overlay and re-promote (clean), (3) abort and rollback. Thoughts?

product: we intentionally enabled beta in this rollout to validate a promo experiment. Rolling back loses experiment telemetry. Prefer republishing to include the values. But we need to confirm no default behavior changed in other services.

oncall-sre: republish is fine but recommend holding traffic cutovers and keep a 30m post-unpause observation window. Also prepare rollback tag as safety.

ops-admin: I'll approve a republish. Who will run it? Also note: registry artifacts require a signed provenance file for audit. Please include that.

diego: I can repackage quickly. Steps: regenerate release bundle with `release-bundle create --chart checkout-6.2.0 --values overrides/promo-beta.yaml --output checkout-6.2.0+promo.tgz` then `chart-publisher --repo artifacts --token $TOKEN`. ETA ~10m.

karen: can we pin the canary while this happens so pods don't flip between configs? deploy-bot previously allowed `release.redwood/pin-values` annotation.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Maintenance pin available. To pin current applied values: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-checkout-2026-04 release.redwood/pin-values=true --overwrite`. When pinned, deploy-bot will skip values blob validation for  the canary. Remove pin after republish to resume validation.

karen: applied pin: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-checkout-2026-04 release.redwood/pin-values=true --overwrite`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Received pin annotation. Canary locked to current applied values. No pod replacements will occur for values drift while pin is present.

diego: starting republish now. Will also attach a provenance file and note the values file hash. Running `sha256sum overrides/promo-beta.yaml` -> `f2c3bd...` and adding it to provenance.

ops-admin: approved. remember to include the provenance URL in the release notes.

product: also add a short blurb about what the beta flag does and the metric we expect to watch (promo conversion rate).

oncall-sre: standing by to watch SLI/SLO and error budget. If error rate crosses threshold we will trigger rollback tag `checkout-6.2.0-rollback-ready`.

diego: publish succeeded. artifact: https://artifacts.internal/charts/checkout/6.2.0+promo.tgz sha256: 5a7b9c... values-hash: f2c3bd... provenance: https://artifacts.internal/prov/checkout/6.2.0+promo.prov

karen: thanks. will remove pin and unpause canary after you promote. `kubectl annotate canary/canary-checkout-2026-04 release.redwood/pin-values-; kubectl patch canary/canary-checkout-2026-04 -p '{"spec":{"paused":false}}' --type=merge`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary resumed. Validating artifact digest + values-hash. Monitoring for 30m. Initial pods report readiness passing.

product: added release note: "promo: enableBeta=true — toggles promo experiment X; watch conversion_pct and error_rate. Artifact: https://artifacts.internal/charts/checkout/6.2.0+promo.tgz Provenance: https://artifacts.internal/prov/checkout/6.2.0+promo.prov"

diego: filing CI ticket to ensure values overlays are included in artifact packaging step (ticket #2522). Linking this thread.

oncall-sre: monitoring dashboards active. will call if metrics breach.

karen: follow-ups: product to update experiment docs, diego to post CI ticket, ops_admin to confirm provenance retention, oncall to monitor for 30m. Closing thread unless rollback is needed.
